context_keys.topic: what the desk is focused on right now
context_keys.quotes/: one key per symbol: the latest receipted quote
context_keys.findings/: one key per finding: evidence worth keeping, with its source clock
context_keys.cases/: one key per trade case: {contract, thesis, evidence: [context keys], invalidation, state: idea|watching|open-simulated|closed, fill, exit, as_of}. invalidation is always written. fill is null until the gates pass: fill_check ok (live receipted regular-session bid/ask supporting the price) AND the member's ask-card confirmation; then it is the receipt's exact {price, bid, ask, quantity, observed_at, confirmed: 'answers/fill-<id>'} block. exit: same shape, closed cases only. Run case_check before writing.
context_keys.answers/: the member's replies to ask cards, one key per card id; a fill's confirmed field names its answer key here
context_keys.desk/next_check: the agent's own next check-in clock (ISO-8601 UTC, >=10 minutes out); the autopilot honors it
context_keys.desk/focus: one line: what the next check-in should look at
context_keys.desk/autopilot: the autopilot's last action: {last_turn, reason, builds_today, budget} — written by tools/autopilot.py, never by the agent
context_keys.widgets/: the desk: one declarative card per key (widgets convention)
context_keys.widgets/brief: the pinned Today card: what the desk is doing and what needs eyes

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Which lanes are live on this machine: inline public data always; the full engine (broker, options, gamma) when installed.

tools.name: price_summary
tools.description: End-of-day price summary from public data — no keys, no accounts. Close, 1d/1m change, 30d range.

args.symbol: ticker or index, e.g. NVDA, SPX

tools.name: daily_bars
tools.description: Daily closes from public data for charting — points ready for a line card.

tools.name: case_check
tools.description: Validate one cases/<id> value against the case contract: thesis, evidence keys, invalidation always written, honest state, and the fill gates. Answers every violation by name.

args.id: the case id, for the summary

tools.name: fill_check
tools.description: The simulated-fill gate. Fetches its own live receipted quote, verifies regular session, freshness, and that the price sits inside bid/ask, then answers with the exact confirmation ask card and fill block. No live receipt, no confirmation offered.

args.price: the simulated fill price to verify
args.contract: display label for the card, e.g. 'NVDA 8/14 190C'

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Check the data engine: TWS, Timescale, integrations.

tools.name: quote_snapshot
tools.description: One receipted IBKR quote: bid/ask/last/mark with source clocks.

args.max_age_seconds: serve cached if fresher than this

tools.name: options_chain
tools.description: A bounded options chain snapshot for one underlying.

tools.name: spx_gamma
tools.description: Latest SPX dealer gamma, strike-level, cached-honest on vendor failure.

args.read_only: true to never hit the vendor

tools.name: implied_move
tools.description: Options-implied move into a dated event.

tools.name: symbol_research
tools.description: The full research pass on one symbol: bars, zones, options.

questions.question: Which underlyings or topics should the desk watch?
questions.placeholder: NVDA, AMD, SPX — or themes: semis into earnings, rate-sensitive names

questions.question: What should the desk focus on right now?
